LanguageData.CarryPolicyTip: Configure shared carry lists and assign them to colonists in the Assign tab. Food amounts are in portions, not items: one portion is what an average adult eats in one meal.
LanguageData.NoCarryEntries: Empty. Check items on the right and press "Add selected".
LanguageData.CarryCountDesc:
Portion is not the same as one item.
For food, one portion is what an average adult eats in a single meal (0.9 nutrition, lasts about 13.5 hours). Pawns that get hungry faster (modded races, genes, ...) automatically carry proportionally more items.
For non-food items the amount is a plain item count.
